name: GitHub Copilot X
description: GitHub Copilot X — chat, slash commands, and PR review in your editor.
note: GitHub account + Copilot subscription required. MCP servers in mcp.json (mcpServers).

name: JetBrains AI Assistant
description: JetBrains AI Assistant — integrated coding agent in IDE with chat and inline completions.
note: IDE-integrated agent (detect-only). Config managed through IDE settings. JetBrains license required.

name: BaseDash
description: BaseDash — AI database query builder (SQL agent).
note: SQL generation and execution. API key required.

name: GitHub Copilot Workspace
description: Copilot Workspace — multi-agent IDE for complex coding tasks (browser-based).
note: Browser-based SaaS; desktop client optional. GitHub Copilot subscription required.

name: Tabnine
description: Tabnine — AI code completion and chat assistant.
note: Free tier available; paid tier unlocks advanced features. IDE extension primary interface.

name: Replit Ghostwriter
description: Replit Ghostwriter — AI coding assistant in the Replit IDE.
note: SaaS-only in Replit IDE; no standalone CLI. Requires Replit account.

name: Databricks SQL Assistant
description: Databricks SQL Assistant — AI query generation and optimization for SQL.
note: SaaS feature in Databricks platform. No standalone CLI; configure through account dashboard.

name: Anthropic Interleave (Internal)
description: Anthropic Interleave — internal multi-turn agent framework (research).
note: Research/beta release. Requires Anthropic API key. Install via Claude API integrations.

name: v0 by Vercel
description: v0 — AI web component and UI generator by Vercel.
note: SaaS-only web UI generator. No CLI; browser-based interface at v0.dev.

name: Cursor Compose
description: Cursor Compose — Cursor's multi-file editing agent.
note: Embedded in Cursor editor. No standalone CLI; use Cursor CLI + Cursor editor for full access.

name: Lambda Labs Hub (Hugging Face Integration)
description: Lambda Labs Hub — Hugging Face-integrated GPU cloud IDE with agents.
note: Cloud-based IDE. SSH tunneling possible; primarily web interface at hub.lambdalabs.com.

name: Lovable.dev
description: Lovable — AI-first full-stack web app generator from Vercel team.
note: SaaS-only. Web UI for building apps with AI. No CLI.

name: Cursor Agent Runtime
description: Cursor Agent Runtime — Cursor's headless agent execution layer (beta).
note: Beta feature. Requires Cursor subscription. Install via npm scoped to @cursor.

name: Claude MCP Server
description: Claude MCP Server — local Claude server with Model Context Protocol support.
note: MCP-native server; Anthropic API key required. Runs a local server for Claude interactions.
